mathematical_meanings: Left image: The open endpoint excludes (3, 2) from the function graph. Right image: The outline is the circumference of the circle plotted around the origin.
Rationales: The feature marks an ordered pair excluded from the plotted trace in the left image and traces the circumference of a geometric circle in the right image. The hollow circle at the right end of the curve at (3, 2). The cyan circle centered where the two axes meet.
